_comment: Edit by hand. Clearance is a decision, not a default.

providers.name: a local OpenAI-compatible model
not_for: L3 work. No provider sees a secret in context; the credential proxy injects it into the request instead.

L2 work when KULI_LOCAL_ENDPOINT points anywhere but loopback. T8 verifies the effective endpoint and demotes this row to L1 on its own, so the figure above is a claim the harness checks rather than one it believes.

providers.name: a hosted Anthropic model
not_for: L2 work. The endpoint is loopback only because it is the egress proxy; the destination is not this machine, and is_loopback refuses a routed URL for exactly that reason.
Any call at all until kuli egress is running and holds the key. This row carries no api_key_env on purpose: the adapter's process must never hold the credential.
